title: macOS Keyboard Shortcuts
description: Essential macOS keyboard shortcuts for window management, navigation, screenshots, and productivity.

entries.label: Spotlight Search
entries.description: Open Spotlight to search files, apps, calculations, and web results instantly

entries.label: Force Quit App
entries.description: Open Force Quit dialog to kill unresponsive applications

entries.label: Screenshot Region
entries.description: Capture a selected area of the screen to clipboard or file

entries.label: Screenshot to Clipboard
entries.description: Hold Ctrl while selecting to copy screenshot directly to clipboard

entries.label: Screen Recording
entries.description: Open screenshot/recording toolbar with options for full screen, window, or selection

entries.label: Switch Between Apps
entries.description: Cycle through open applications. Hold Cmd and press Tab repeatedly.

entries.label: Switch Between Windows
entries.description: Cycle between windows of the same application

entries.label: Mission Control
entries.description: Show all open windows and desktops in bird's-eye view

entries.label: Lock Screen
entries.description: Instantly lock your Mac without putting it to sleep

entries.label: Show Desktop
entries.description: Temporarily push all windows aside to reveal the desktop

entries.label: Emoji Picker
entries.description: Open the emoji and special characters picker in any text field

entries.label: Delete Word Before Cursor
entries.description: Delete the entire word before the cursor instead of one character
